item.title: Israel strikes Iran as drone hits Bahrain refinery, oil surges past $115 and Trump defends price spike
item.description: Israeli airstrikes hit regime targets in Isfahan as Iranian drone attack injures dozens at Bahrain refinery; oil jumps above $115 while Donald Trump says higher prices are a 'very small price to pay' for global security

item.title: Israel strikes labs linked to Iran's nuclear program near Tehran
item.description: Satellite images show damage at missile and air defense sites near Tehran, Parchin and Shahroud, with a large smoke plume rising over the capital after strikes on Iranian oil facilities

item.title: Israel, US devastate Iran’s aging air force as decades-old jets fall to modern fighters
item.description: IDF gained rapid air superiority over Tehran as strikes destroyed aircraft on the ground and exposed how decades of sanctions left Iran reliant on missiles and drones instead of a modern air force

item.title: Americans in Israel describe fear, pride and exhaustion as war with Iran unfolds
item.description: Living through the conflict presents daily challenges as they juggle work, children and the stress of constant sirens

item.title: Hezbollah claims strike on satellite station in central Israel after rocket barrage
item.description: Rocket fire from Lebanon wounds 18 and damages buildings, including a kindergarten, as sirens sound across Tel Aviv and the Shfela before the IDF strikes the launcher

item.title: IDF launches targeted raid in southern Lebanon: 'The end is not near, it will take time'
item.description: Israeli forces doubled troop levels along the Lebanon border and launched a focused raid against Hezbollah near the frontier, while airstrikes continued in Iran against regime command centers and missile sites’

item.title: One dead, one critical after missile strike at central Israel construction site; man seriously hurt elsewhere
item.description: Iran fires missile barrages across Israel as rockets are also launched from Lebanon; air defenses intercept most threats, but a missile with a split warhead hits central Israel, killing a man and critically wounding another at a Yehud construction site; IDF strikes Hezbollah t...

item.title: Netanyahu urges Iranians to cast off ‘yoke of tyranny’
item.description: PM says the Iranian people must ultimately decide their future, as Israel continues strikes on the regime and seeks lasting change in the region

item.title: Report: Lebanon asks Trump administration to broker direct talks with Israel to end war
item.description: Outreach reportedly included a proposal for immediate minister-level talks in Cyprus, but US and Israeli officials respond with skepticism, signaling negotiations would require concrete steps to disarm Hezbollah

item.title: Report: Trump Gaza plan on hold due to war with Iran
item.description: Negotiations on Hamas disarmament and reconstruction efforts stall as US and Israeli strikes on Iran shift Washington’s focus and disrupt regional mediation efforts
